summary: ExpenseBatch represents a data and workflow structure for managing grouped expenses within a department. The system allows searching, creating, updating, and deleting expense batches, providing both a formatted batch identifier and multilingual support for status descriptions.
purpose: To manage batches of expenses for departments, including creation, search, update, and deletion, and to provide descriptive and status-driven batch identification for administrative and operational purposes.

entities.name: ExpenseBatch
entities.description: A batch containing grouped expenses, associated with a department and status codes.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the expense batch

fields.name: DepartmentID
fields.description: Identifier for the department associated with the batch

fields.name: BatchDate
fields.description: Date when the batch was created

fields.name: StatusCodeID
fields.description: Identifier for the status code of the batch

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.description: Code representing the status of the batch

fields.name: StatusDescription
fields.description: Description of the batch's status, supports alternate language fields

fields.name: ClosedDate
fields.description: Date when the batch was closed

fields.name: BatchNumberFormatted
fields.description: Formatted identifier combining the batch ID and status description

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.description: Session context used to access and manipulate batch data

workflows.name: Search ExpenseBatch
steps: Map database fields to ExpenseBatch structure, including language-aware status description

workflows.name: Add ExpenseBatch
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, DepartmentID, BatchDescription, BatchDate
Retrieve new batch ID from database

workflows.name: Update ExpenseBatch
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, ID, BatchDescription, BatchDate, StatusCodeID

business_rules: StatusDescription uses alternate language fields if session mandates
BatchNumberFormatted is constructed as ID + ' - ' + StatusDescription
validations: Ensure ID and DepartmentID are integer values
BatchDate and ClosedDate must be valid DateTime
StatusCodeID must be provided for update
conditions: StatusDescription uses alternate language if sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true
system_behavior: Session context controls procedure invocation and language field selection
ExpenseBatch entity is constructed from database fields
Batch operations are encapsulated within stored procedures
dependencies: Relies on HSPnetSession for DB procedure and language selection
Depends on stored procedures: ExpenseBatchSearch, ExpenseBatchSearchID, ExpenseBatchAdd, ExpenseBatchUpdate, ExpenseBatchDelete
exceptions: Null SqlDataReader results in empty batch or no update
Failed database queries return default values or exit workflow early
content_gaps: No explicit validation for input data beyond type checks
No details on batch expense items or approval workflow
